issues.description: The problem statement (UML and task) requires a Lecture constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) and specifies attention to parameter order. The template, however, provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). The solution implements a five-parameter constructor. This constructor-parameter mismatch in the template will confuse students and prevent them from following the specified constructor signature/order without modifying the provided starter code.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the constructor signature in the template to match the specification/UML and the solution: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { /* either leave body TODO or assign fields */ }. Ensure the parameter order matches the UML and either provide an empty body with a TODO comment or initialize the (also-to-be-added) attributes. This preserves the pedagogical intent (students implement bodies/getters/setters) while removing the structural mismatch.
